23:         return not result

50:         self.name = name
51:         self.default = default
52:

54:         return f"Variable(name={self.name}, default={self.default})"

2: from abc import ABCMeta, abstractmethod
3: from typing import Iterator, Mapping, Optional, Pattern

5: _posix_variable: Pattern[str] = re.compile(
6:     r"""
7:     \$\{
8:         (?P<name>[^\}:]*)
9:         (?::-
10:             (?P<default>[^\}]*)
11:         )?
12:     \}
13:     """,
14:     re.VERBOSE,
15: )
16: 
17: 
18: class Atom(metaclass=ABCMeta):
19:     def __ne__(self, other: object) -> bool:
20:         result = self.__eq__(other)
21:         if result is NotImplemented:
22:             return NotImplemented
23:         return not result
24: 
25:     @abstractmethod
26:     def resolve(self, env: Mapping[str, Optional[str]]) -> str: ...
27: 
28: 
29: class Literal(Atom):
30:     def __init__(self, value: str) -> None:
31:         self.value = value
32: 
33:     def __repr__(self) -> str:
34:         return f"Literal(value={self.value})"
35: 
36:     def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
37:         if not isinstance(other, self.__class__):
38:             return NotImplemented
39:         return self.value == other.value
40: 
41:     def __hash__(self) -> int:
42:         return hash((self.__class__, self.value))
43: 
44:     def resolve(self, env: Mapping[str, Optional[str]]) -> str:
45:         return self.value
46: 
47: 
48: class Variable(Atom):
49:     def __init__(self, name: str, default: Optional[str]) -> None:
50:         self.name = name
51:         self.default = default
52: 
53:     def __repr__(self) -> str:
54:         return f"Variable(name={self.name}, default={self.default})"
55: 
56:     def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
57:         if not isinstance(other, self.__class__):
58:             return NotImplemented
59:         return (self.name, self.default) == (other.name, other.default)
60: 
61:     def __hash__(self) -> int:
62:         return hash((self.__class__, self.name, self.default))
63: 
64:     def resolve(self, env: Mapping[str, Optional[str]]) -> str:
65:         default = self.default if self.default is not None else ""
66:         result = env.get(self.name, default)
67:         return result if result is not None else ""

82:         cursor = end

     2	import os

     4	from unittest.mock import patch

     9	
    10	class Acceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    11	    def test_default(self):
    12	        self.assertEqual(Variable("MISSING", "fallback").resolve({}), "fallback")
    13	        self.assertEqual(Variable("X", "fallback").resolve({"X": "present"}), "present")
    14	
    15	    def test_literal(self):
    16	        self.assertEqual(Literal("hello").resolve({}), "hello")
    17	
    18	    def test_none(self):
    19	        self.assertEqual(Variable("X", "fallback").resolve({"X": None}), "")
    20	
    21	    def test_trailing(self):
    22	        def resolve(text):
    23	            env = {"X": "value", "Y": "second"}
    24	            return "".join(atom.resolve(env) for atom in parse_variables(text))
    25	        self.assertEqual(resolve("literal"), "literal")
    26	        self.assertEqual(resolve("pre-${X}-post"), "pre-value-post")
    27	        self.assertEqual(resolve("${X}${Y}"), "valuesecond")
    28	
    29	    def test_unquoted(self):
    30	        rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO("X=value   \nY=word # comment\n")))
    31	        self.assertEqual([row.value for row in rows], ["value", "word"])
    32	
    33	    def test_escape(self):
    34	        rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO('X="line\\nnext"\n')))
    35	        self.assertEqual(rows[0].value, "line\nnext")
    36	
    37	    def test_lines(self):
    38	        rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO("X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n")))
    39	        self.assertEqual([row.original.line for row in rows], [1, 2, 3])
    40	
    41	    def test_override(self):
    42	        for override, expected in [(True, "new"), (False, "old")]:
    43	            with patch.dict(os.environ, {"YECODING_SAMPLE": "old"}, clear=True):
    44	                stream = io.StringIO("YECODING_SAMPLE=new")
    45	                instance = DotEnv(None, stream=stream, override=override)
    46	                self.assertTrue(instance.set_as_environment_variables())
    47	                self.assertEqual(os.environ["YECODING_SAMPLE"], expected)
    48	
    49	    def test_interpolation(self):
    50	        for enabled, expected in [(True, "one"), (False, "${A}")]:
    51	            with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
    52	                values = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO("A=one\nB=${A}\n"), interpolate=enabled)
    53	                self.assertEqual(values["B"], expected)
